Foundation & platform

Make the rules visible.

Temple and Sourcery form the execution foundation and authoring platform beneath this ecosystem. I want power, permission and change to have an account people can inspect.

ExecutionFoundation

Temple

Accountable execution. Explicit rules, checked changes and a history you can inspect.

I want execution and change to remain inspectable.
